heroBody: The Dyson V15 Detect is Dyson's flagship cordless stick vacuum, and US pricing has stayed stubbornly close to its MSRP for years — except during a handful of retailer promotions and on the Dyson outlet. This page pulls the live US listings from BuyWhere's catalog every few minutes so you can see the current floor price, which retailer is undercutting, and whether the cheapest listing is a new sealed unit with a Dyson warranty or an 'Open Box' / 'Certified Refurbished' listing that trades warranty terms for a real discount.

highlightSectionTitle: What to know before you buy a Dyson V15

highlights.title: Detect vs older V15 models
highlights.body: The current 'V15 Detect' ships with the laser-illuminated cleaner head that makes dust visible on hard floors. Earlier V15 Animal / V15 Absolute stock still surfaces on the secondhand market and at outlet prices, but those kits ship without the laser head and are usually a worse buy at any small price gap.

highlights.title: Refurbished stock from Dyson
highlights.body: Dyson.com lists 'Certified Refurbished' V15 Detect units for a meaningful discount off the MSRP with the same 2-year warranty as new. This is the single best value play if you do not need an unopened box — third-party 'renewed' listings on Amazon are a different story with shorter Dyson-backed coverage.

highlights.title: Bundles vs bare unit
highlights.body: Retailers often bundle the V15 with extra batteries, a wall dock or a hair screw tool. If the bundle price is only modestly above the bare unit and you actually want the accessory, take the bundle; if it is meaningfully over and you do not need the extras, skip it — bare units are heavily stocked.

adviceSectionTitle: How to pay the least without getting burned
advicePoints: Time it: Dyson.com rarely discounts the V15 outside Black Friday and a Memorial Day promo. Amazon and Best Buy undercut more often and earlier — set a price alert on this page rather than waiting for a single day.
Prefer Dyson Certified Refurbished over third-party 'Open Box' listings from unknown sellers: same 2-year Dyson warranty, materially cheaper, and Dyson ships the new sealed packaging directly.
Check Costco's price even if you only renew occasionally: Costco has a near-permanent undercut and stacks with the Costco 2-year electronics return window on top of the Dyson warranty.
Avoid listings well below the market floor with no reviews or stock photos. They are usually bait-and-switch, refurbished-as-new or dropshipped grey-market units that Dyson will not service.
If you mostly vacuum hard floors with the occasional carpet run, the V12 Detect Slim is usually a smarter buy at half the price — the V15 only earns its premium on larger homes with pets.
faqSectionTitle: Dyson V15 in the US — common questions

faqs.question: Is the Dyson V15 worth it over the V12 in the US?
faqs.answer: If you have a larger home, multiple floor types or pets shedding year-round, yes — the V15's larger bin and swappable battery justify the premium. For apartments and lighter cleaning, the V12 Detect Slim delivers most of the laser-dust experience at roughly half the price.

faqs.question: When is the Dyson V15 cheapest in the US?
faqs.answer: Historically around Black Friday, Memorial Day and Prime Day. Costco undercuts MSRP year-round. Dyson Certified Refurbished on Dyson.com is the most reliable off-season discount.

faqs.question: Does the Dyson V15 come with a warranty in the US?
faqs.answer: Yes — 2-year Dyson limited warranty when bought new from Dyson.com, an authorised Dyson retailer, or a major US retailer. Third-party 'renewed' listings on Amazon are backed only by the seller's shorter warranty.

faqs.question: What's the difference between V15 Detect and V15s Detect?
faqs.answer: The V15s Detect adds a Submarine wet roller head for hard-floor washing, turning it into a hybrid vacuum-mop. If you do not want the wet function, the standard V15 Detect is the cheaper pick.

categoryIntro.heading: Why US Dyson V15 prices barely move
categoryIntro.body: Dyson controls the V15's US distribution tightly: the official MSRP holds across most of the year, and the real discounts come from a small set of places — Dyson's own outlet, Costco's near-permanent undercut, and a handful of major sale days at Amazon, Best Buy and Target. A static 'best price' article goes stale within days, so this page reads live listings instead.
